description: The record of a loop-layer decision: pattern, tools, approvals, budgets, durability and failure modes, with the forces, alternatives and consequences behind them.
The implementable part of the decision: goal, tools, approval rules, budgets, stuck limit, what happens when a budget ends, durability and expected failures.
Granting an agent only the tools its task needs, so mistakes and injected instructions have the smallest possible reach.
The budget that fires first for a given run; coherent budgets make the intended limit (usually steps) the binding one.
The defined outcome for a run that cannot finish: the task returns to a person with the conversation attached.
